\caption{Single-grain zircon (U--Th)/He data for the Montreal River monocline, listed by sample group. The reduced data are archived as data/UTh\_He\_zircon\_data.csv in the project repository; the underlying laboratory report files are archived in the \texttt{projects\_2023/TA23\_MRM\_MCR} directory of the \texttt{wrguenthner/HAL\_data} repository. ``Rpt.'' identifies the laboratory report file (\texttt{TA23\_MRM\_MCR\_$n$\_report.csv}) that an analysis is taken from. Mass is the aliquot mass from the measured grain dimensions, $R$ is the grain radius used in the $\alpha$-ejection correction and in the diffusion calculations, and $F_T$ is the $\alpha$-ejection correction. He, U, and Th amounts are followed in parentheses by their 1$\sigma$ analytical uncertainties expressed as a percentage of the amount. Concentrations are calculated from these amounts and the aliquot mass, and eU~=~[U]~+~0.235[Th]. ``Raw date'' is the date before the $\alpha$-ejection correction and ``corrected date'' is the date after it; both are given with the 1$\sigma$ uncertainties returned by the laboratory data reduction, which propagate analytical uncertainties only and do not include uncertainty in $F_T$ or dispersion between grains. Sm was not determined for the zircon aliquots. 9 grains have two U--Th determinations reported for the same He aliquot: the He measurement, mass, radius, and $F_T$ of the two rows are identical and only the U--Th determination, and hence the date, differs. Both determinations are listed, labeled (a) and (b) in the order in which they appear in the archived data file, and both are carried through the analyses in the project repository. Grains flagged as excluded are the analyses filtered out as spurious in the project repository. Superscript symbols in the ``Notes'' column are defined beneath the table. The Fish Canyon Tuff zircon aliquots reported here give a mean date of 25.2~Ma with a standard deviation of 4.6~Ma ($n$~=~18).}\label{tab:zircon_UThHe} \\
